description: This file defines a Svelte component for a status bar displaying task counts and their proportions by status (todo, in progress, done). It includes reactive calculations for total tasks and percentage widths for progress bars, along with corresponding styles.
calls: $: pct = { todo: total ? (tasksByStatus.todo / total) * 100 : 0, in_progress: total ? (tasksByStatus.in_progress / total) * 100 : 0, done: total ? (tasksByStatus.done / total) : 0 }
